title: Placement fast-path box refusal is silent and untested: no else branch sets last_reject, so the Box_Piece_Exhausted toast label is unreachable dead code
detail: Ruling 4 names place-tiers-you-hold as THE biggest behavioral change; its refusal (era-3 piece wall) surfaces nothing — only commit_draw teaches — and no test covers it. Ghost preview (validate_place) ignores the box too.
recommended_fix: Add the same else branch (last_reject/reject_tick) to Place_Release, and extend exec_test.odin with a box-on placement-refusal test asserting last_reject == .Box_Piece_Exhausted and nothing applied/logged.

title: Same-spool resplice net-zero branch (must never refuse on a short spool) has zero coverage and the fixture cannot express it
detail: The designed anti-false-'no' invariant is untested: box_test's only resplice tests (lines 206/212) are cross-spool; no fixture pair shares the fiber spool, so the net-zero path never executes.
recommended_fix: Add a test: draw narrow/standard, drain the standard spool low, resplice narrow->standard (same spool) and expect .None with stock unchanged; optionally give mid the fiber spool in the fixture.

title: Eras.json dead-stock spool guard (a real bug caught in review) has no rejection test row
detail: The comment records this guard catches a real historical bug, yet catalog_test.odin's box rows end at 'box spool decrease era 2' (line 975) — the regression it exists for is unpinned and could silently regress.
recommended_fix: Add a fail-fast row: an era-2 row with "spools": {"fiber": 40} while mid/wide unlock at era 3, expecting the 'no %s-spool tier unlocks by era' rejection.

title: Stats B/J calibration rows have no test: box-on CSV output and the stats_compute box section are entirely uncovered
detail: These rows are the L5 tuning evidence pipeline (--stats-out); stats_test.odin has zero box coverage, so a column/format/cap-lookup error corrupts calibration evidence silently.
recommended_fix: Add a stats test: box-on run via box_test fixtures, assert the B row fields (stocks/caps/clock) and one J row per granted type, plus box-off streams staying box-row-free.

title: Unpriceable-command pass-through branches untested; the claimed validate/charge lockstep invariant is not actually pinned by a test
detail: No box-on test drives an unpriceable command (unknown tier, non-junction type) to prove the topology's canonical error wins and charge never runs on it.
recommended_fix: Add a box-on test: draw with tier >= len(pipe_tiers) and place with a terminal type_idx; expect the topology errors and box stock byte-unchanged.

title: Two box catalog guards lack rejection rows: the 2^40 interval wrap bound and the era_introduced piece-cap check
detail: Every sibling box guard has a fail-fast test row; these two do not, so either could be deleted or broken without a red test.
recommended_fix: Add two rows to the balance/eras rejection tables: dot_interval_ticks = 2^41, and a box.pieces cap on router_mid in an era-1 row (unlocks era 3).

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 100% (16/16 core economy paths: grammar, cap, clock, floor pin, replay+serialize, draw toast). P1 50% (placement refusal surface NONE). Overall ~68% (19/28 FULL-or-PARTIAL) — below the 80% gate.
recommended_fix: Cover the placement-refusal surface (with the missing feedback branch), the same-spool resplice invariant, the dead-stock spool guard, and the stats B/J rows; re-run gate — P1 to >=90% and overall to >=80%.
